name: HighLevel
description: HighLevel lets agents read and update contacts, conversations, opportunities, and calendars in the signed-in HighLevel sub-account. Each user signs in to their own HighLevel account through the browser.

prompts.text: List the contacts that were added this week.
Summarize the opportunities in my sales pipeline by stage.
What appointments are booked on my calendar tomorrow?

apps.name: HighLevel
apps.description: Contact, conversation, opportunity, and calendar access, over HighLevel's MCP server with browser sign-in.
